messages:
maria-peopleops: Quick update: Execs approved a small hiring bump for Runtime and a leadership tweak. Short version: +4 roles, one manager promotion, one backfill. Details below.

kevin-cto: Thanks team  this should unblock a few latency and rollout projects.

maria-peopleops: Hiring breakdown: 2 Senior Inference Engineers (Core), 1 Senior Backend Engineer (Runtime Ops), 1 Staff SRE. Tanya will be promoted to Sr Manager, Runtime Ops (effective next Mon). We'll open reqs after calibration.

tanya-ramos: Thanks everyone  happy to take the role. My immediate focus: autoscaling policies, rollout reliability, and on-call ramp for new SRE.

jen-recruiter: I'll create the 4 reqs in Greenhouse today. Hiring managers please add panelists by Friday EOD. Interview emphasis: Core = profiling + quantization; Ops = deploy infra + incident handling.

hr-bot: Reminder: submit role descriptions for salary banding by 11:59pm PT Thu.

maria-peopleops: Action items: 1) Managers add panels in GH; 2) Recruiter posts JDs in #recruiting; 3) People Ops schedules a brief all-hands intro for Tanya next Tue 10am PT. DM me with any concerns. :sparkles:
